text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega doesn't show up for training. After some looking around, I finally find her in the library.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I call out to her but notice that she's fast asleep.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Oh… Trainer? What are you… doing here?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I was searching for information to help with my races… and I must have dozed off.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry. I'll be more careful from now on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While I'm slightly concerned that she's overworking herself, I give her a fair and proper warning.
